title: Innovative Approaches in Non-Traditional Optimization Methods Used in Geothermal Power Plants: Artificial Neural Networks and Genetic Algorithms
content: In this study, a general description of geothermal power plants is provided, and the optimization methods used are summarized. Following the review of these optimization methods, the advantages of heuristic methods and the success of the developed models are demonstrated. The challenges in optimizing geothermal systems, including the limitations due to the complexity and the use of multiple parameters, are discussed. Heuristic methods, particularly the widely used artificial neural networks and genetic algorithms, are explained in general terms. The application of artificial neural networks and genetic algorithms in the optimization of geothermal power plants is elucidated with the help of literature. Recent studies highlight that the combined use of artificial neural networks and genetic algorithms can produce faster and more consistent results. This demonstrates the benefits of using non-traditional methods for geothermal resource utilization and power plant optimization. An innovative optimization method has been developed using the operational data of an ORC geothermal power plant in the city of Izmir. The developed calculation method has identified the optimal operating conditions that provide a 39.41% increase in net power output. The plant's gross power generation has been increased from 4,943 kW to 6,624 kW.
